name: What are the key steps in implementing a GEO strategy for my accounting practice?

mainEntity.name: What are the key steps in implementing a GEO strategy for my accounting practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing a GEO strategy involves several key steps: first, optimizing your Google Business Profile with accurate and complete information; second, building consistent local citations across various directories; third, optimizing your website content for local keywords; and finally, acquiring local reviews from satisfied clients. Continuous monitoring and adjustment based on performance data are also crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key steps include optimizing Google Business Profile, building local citations, localizing website content, and acquiring client reviews for effective GEO strategy.
